import * as THREE from 'three';

const Y_AXIS = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
const Z_AXIS = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);

const { clamp, damp } = THREE.MathUtils;

function wrapAngle(a: number): number {
  return Math.atan2(Math.sin(a), Math.cos(a));
}

function tangentYaw(t: THREE.Vector3): number {
  return Math.atan2(t.x, t.z);
}

function signedCurvature(prevT: THREE.Vector3, curT: THREE.Vector3, ds: number): number {
  if (ds < 1e-4) return 0;
  return wrapAngle(tangentYaw(curT) - tangentYaw(prevT)) / ds;
}

function dampVec3(v: THREE.Vector3, target: THREE.Vector3, lambda: number, dt: number): void {
  v.x = damp(v.x, target.x, lambda, dt);
  v.y = damp(v.y, target.y, lambda, dt);
  v.z = damp(v.z, target.z, lambda, dt);
}

function solveTwoBoneIK(
  rootA: THREE.Vector3,
  target: THREE.Vector3,
  l1: number,
  l2: number,
  pole: THREE.Vector3,
  outElbow: THREE.Vector3,
  outEnd: THREE.Vector3
): boolean {
  const toTarget = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(target, rootA);
  let d = toTarget.length();
  if (d < 1e-6) { toTarget.set(0, 0, 1); d = 1e-6; }
  const dir = toTarget.normalize();
  const dMin = Math.abs(l1 - l2) + 1e-4;
  const dMax = l1 + l2 - 1e-4;
  const reachable = d >= dMin && d <= dMax;
  const dClamped = clamp(d, dMin, dMax);
  const along = (l1 * l1 - l2 * l2 + dClamped * dClamped) / (2 * dClamped);
  const h = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, l1 * l1 - along * along));
  const poleDir = new THREE.Vector3().subVectors(pole, rootA);
  poleDir.addScaledVector(dir, -poleDir.dot(dir));
  if (poleDir.lengthSq() < 1e-8) {
    poleDir.crossVectors(Z_AXIS, dir);
    if (poleDir.lengthSq() < 1e-8) poleDir.crossVectors(Y_AXIS, dir);
  }
  poleDir.normalize();
  outElbow.copy(rootA).addScaledVector(dir, along).addScaledVector(poleDir, h);
  outEnd.copy(rootA).addScaledVector(dir, dClamped);
  return reachable;
}
